VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (what dinosaurs are) Ang mga dinosaur ay sinaunang mga reptilya (reptiles) na namuhay sa Earth mga 230 hanggang 66 milyong taon na ang nakalipas. HINDI sila mga mammals — mas malapit sila sa mga modernong reptilya at ibon. Iba-iba ang laki nila, mula sa maliit hanggang sa napakalaki.
- (fossils) Ang fossils ay mga labi o bakas ng mga halaman at hayop noong unang panahon na napreserba sa bato. Tumutulong ang mga ito sa mga siyentista na malaman kung anong nabuhay sa Earth milyon-milyong taon na ang nakalipas.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pakita mo naman ang T-rex!

Heto po ang T-rex — isang dambuhalang theropod na kumakain ng karne!

[image: A Tyrannosaurus rex dinosaur with massive jaws, tiny arms, and a long tail.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (magnets attract iron and steel) Ang magnet ay umaakit lamang sa ilang mga metal tulad ng bakal at asero, hindi sa lahat ng metal gaya ng tanso o aluminyo.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Ano po ang hitsura ng triceratops? Pakita mo naman.

Heto ang triceratops — kilala sa tatlong sungay sa mukha nito!

[image: A triceratops dinosaur with three horns and a large neck frill.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (what is a fossil) Ang fossil ay ang naiwang bakas o labi ng halaman o hayop na matagal nang nabuhay, na napreserba sa loob ng bato.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pakita mo naman ng fossil ng dinosaur!

Heto ang fossil ng dinosaur — bakas ng hayop na nabuhay milyon-milyong taon na ang nakalipas!

[image: A dinosaur fossil skeleton embedded in rock.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (whale shark butanding) Ang butanding (whale shark) ay ang pinakamalaking isda sa mundo, ngunit isa itong mabait na hayop na may magagandang puting puntik sa likod.
- (whale shark feeding) Bagamat napakalaki, ang butanding ay kumakain lamang ng maliliit na plankton sa pamamagitan ng pagsala ng tubig dagat sa malaki nitong bibig.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Patingin po ng butanding!

Heto po ang butanding — ang pinakamalaking isda sa buong mundo!

[image: A whale shark swimming with its wide flat mouth and spotted back.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (how a rainbow forms) Nabubuo ang bahaghari kapag ang liwanag ng araw ay dumaan sa mga patak ng ulan na humahati nito sa pitong kulay.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

May picture ka ba ng whale shark?

Meron! Heto ang whale shark o butanding — isda ito kahit napakalaki!

[image: A whale shark (butanding) with white spots swimming in the sea.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (jellyfish body) Ang dikya (jellyfish) ay walang utak, walang puso, at walang buto — halos puro tubig lamang ang katawan nito. Kahit ganoon, milyun-milyong taon na itong nabubuhay sa dagat.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Gusto kong makita ang dikya!

Heto ang dikya — kakaibang hayop na walang utak!

[image: A jellyfish with a round bell and long trailing tentacles.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (the water cycle) Sa siklo ng tubig, ang tubig ay sumisingaw mula sa dagat, lumalamig at nagiging ulap, at bumabagsak muli bilang ulan.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Ipakita mo nga ang kabayong-dagat.

Heto ang kabayong-dagat o seahorse — totoong isda ito!

[image: A seahorse with a curled tail floating upright in the water.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (starfish) Ang bituin sa dagat (starfish) ay karaniwang may limang braso, at kayang nitong magpatubo muli ng nawalang braso. Wala itong utak ni dugo na tulad natin.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pwede po bang makita ang starfish?

Heto ang starfish — kaya nitong palaguin muli ang naputol na braso!

[image: A starfish with five arms on the sea floor.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (sound travels through air) Ang tunog ay naglalakbay sa hangin mula sa pinagmulan nito hanggang sa ating tainga.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Picture naman ng kuwago please!

Heto ang kuwago — bihasang mangangaso sa gabi!

[image: An owl (kuwago) with big round eyes perched on a branch.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (bat echolocation) Ang paniki ay gumagamit ng echolocation para makahanap ng pagkain sa dilim — naglalabas ito ng tunog at pinakikinggan ang alingawngaw na bumabalik para malaman kung saan ang insekto o hadlang.
- (bat only flying mammal) Ang paniki ang tanging mammal na talagang nakakalipad gamit ang mga pakpak nito.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Show mo naman yung paniki!

Heto ang paniki — ang tanging mammal na talagang nakakalipad!

[image: A bat flying at night with wings spread wide.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (why a cold glass sweats) 'Pumapawis' ang malamig na baso dahil ang singaw ng tubig sa mainit na hangin ay dumidikit sa malamig na ibabaw, nawawalan ng lakas, at nagiging maliliit na patak ng tubig. Ito ang condensation — kabaligtaran ng evaporation.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Patingin naman ng buwaya!

Heto po ang buwaya — isa sa pinakamalakas kumagat na hayop!

[image: A crocodile (buwaya) with a long snout and sharp teeth.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (penguins swim instead of fly) Ang mga penguin ay ibong hindi nakakalipad, ngunit ginagamit nila ang kanilang mga pakpak na parang sagwan upang lumangoy sa ilalim ng tubig.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

May larawan ka ba ng penguin?

Meron! Heto ang penguin — ibong hindi nakakalipad pero mahusay lumangoy!

[image: A penguin standing upright on ice.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (gravity pulls objects down) Ang grabidad ay isang puwersa na humihila sa mga bagay pababa patungo sa lupa.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pakita mo po ang elepante!

Heto po ang elepante — ang pinakamalaking hayop sa lupa!

[image: An elephant grabbing leaves with its long trunk.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (tallest animal giraffe) Ang giraffe ang pinakamatangkad na hayop sa mundo, umaabot ng halos 5 hanggang 6 na metro ang taas. Mahaba ang leeg nito para makaabot sa mga dahon sa matataas na puno.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Gusto ko pong makita ang giraffe!

Heto ang giraffe — ang pinakamatangkad na hayop sa mundo!

[image: A giraffe with a very long neck eating leaves from a tall tree.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (small static shocks are harmless) Ang maliit na pagkuryente na nararamdaman pagkatapos kumiskis sa karpet ay static electricity at hindi nakakapinsala.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Ipakita mo naman ang suso!

Heto ang suso — dala-dala niya ang bahay niyang shell!

[image: A snail (suso) with a spiral shell.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (spider webs) Gumagawa ang gagamba ng sapot (web) mula sa sariling sutla (silk) na napakatibay para manghuli ng insektong pagkain nito.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Patingin ng sapot ng gagamba!

Heto ang sapot ng gagamba — hinabi mula sa sutlang gawa ng katawan niya!

[image: A spider web with a spider at the center.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (wet clothes dry by evaporation in sun and wind) Natutuyo ang basang damit sa sampayan dahil sumisingaw ang tubig dito patungo sa hangin, lalo na kapag mainit ang araw at may hangin.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

May pic ka ba ng bubuyog?

Meron! Heto ang bubuyog — masipag na tagapagdala ng pollen!

[image: A bee collecting nectar from a flower.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (Jupiter's Great Red Spot) Ang Great Red Spot ng Jupiter ay isang higanteng bagyo na mas malaki pa sa buong Earth at umiikot na nang daan-daang taon.
- (the planet Jupiter) Ang Jupiter ang pinakamalaking planeta — isang higanteng bola ng gas na napakalaki kaya kasya rito ang lahat ng ibang planeta.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pakita mo ang planetang Jupiter!

Heto ang Jupiter — ang pinakamalaking planeta sa solar system!

[image: The planet Jupiter with its colorful bands and Great Red Spot.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (like poles repel unlike poles attract) Ang magkaparehong poste ng dalawang magnet ay nagtataboy, ngunit ang magkasalungat na poste ay umaakit sa isa't isa.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Anong itsura ng kometa? Pakita mo!

Heto ang kometa — may mahabang buntot itong gas at alikabok!

[image: A comet with a bright head and a long glowing tail in space.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (solar eclipse happens at new moon) Nagkakaroon ng solar eclipse kapag dumadaan ang buwan sa pagitan ng Earth at Araw, kaya humaharang ito sa liwanag at bumabagsak ang anino ng buwan sa Earth. Nangyayari lang ito kapag bagong buwan.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pwede bang makita ang solar eclipse?

Heto ang solar eclipse — natatakpan ng buwan ang araw!

[image: A solar eclipse with the moon blocking the sun, corona glowing.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (types of clouds) May iba't ibang uri ng ulap: ang cumulus ay parang bulak, ang stratus ay nakapatong na manipis, at ang cirrus ay matangkad at parang buhok.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Patingin po ng iba't ibang ulap!

Heto ang iba't ibang uri ng ulap sa langit!

[image: A chart of different cloud types: cirrus, cumulus, and stratus.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (Day and night from Earth's rotation) Nagkakaroon tayo ng araw at gabi dahil umiikot ang Daigdig sa sarili nitong axis isang beses kada 24 oras, kaya ang bahaging nakaharap sa Araw ay araw at ang nasa likod ay gabi.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Gusto kong makita ang talon!

Heto po ang talon — rumaragasang tubig mula sa itaas!

[image: A tall waterfall pouring down a rocky cliff.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (Bangui wind farm Philippines) Ang Bangui Wind Farm sa Ilocos Norte ay may hanay ng malalaking windmill sa tabing-dagat na gumagawa ng kuryente mula sa hangin.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pakita mo yung mga windmill sa Bangui!

Heto ang mga windmill — ginagawang kuryente ang lakas ng hangin!

[image: Tall wind turbines turning in the wind.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (why thunder comes after lightning) Nakikita muna natin ang kidlat bago marinig ang kulog dahil mas mabilis maglakbay ang liwanag kaysa sa tunog.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

May picture ka ba ng telescope?

Meron! Heto ang telescope — pinapalapit nito ang tanawin ng kalangitan!

[image: A telescope on a tripod aimed at the stars.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (microscopes show living things are made of cells) Sa tulong ng mikroskopyo, nakita ng mga siyentipiko na ang mga halaman at hayop ay gawa sa maliliit na selula.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Ipakita mo po ang microscope!

Heto ang microscope — pinapakita nito ang sobrang liliit na bagay!

[image: A microscope for looking at very small things.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (objects fall at the same rate) Kung walang hangin na humahadlang, ang isang mabigat at magaang bagay ay magkasabay na bumabagsak dahil pinapabilis sila ng grabidad sa parehong dami.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pakita mo naman ang saranggola!

Heto ang saranggola — itinataas ito ng lakas ng hangin!

[image: A diamond-shaped kite (saranggola) flying in the wind.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (banana plant is a giant herb) Kahit tinatawag nating "puno ng saging," hindi ito tunay na puno — walang matigas na kahoy ang tangkay nito. Ang saging ay isang napakalaking damo, at ang "tangkay" ay mga dahong magkakapatong.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Patingin po ng puno ng saging!

Heto ang saging — ang totoo, malaking halamang-damo ito at hindi tunay na puno!

[image: A banana plant (saging) with large leaves and bunches of bananas.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (Moon gravity is about one-sixth of Earth's) Ang grabidad sa Buwan ay mga isang-kaanim lamang ng grabidad sa Daigdig.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Ano hitsura ng palay? Pakita mo naman!

Heto ang palay — uri ito ng damo na pinagkukunan ng bigas natin!

[image: Rice plants (palay) growing in a flooded rice field.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (fungi are not plants) Ang kabute at amag ay fungi, hindi halaman. Hindi sila berde at hindi sila gumagawa ng sariling pagkain; kumukuha sila ng sustansya mula sa patay o nabubulok na bagay.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

May larawan ka ba ng kabute?

Meron! Heto ang kabute — hindi ito halaman kundi fungus!

[image: A mushroom (kabute) with a cap and stem.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (volcanic ash cloud and ashfall) Kapag sumasabog ang bulkan, maaari itong magbuga ng makapal na ulap ng abo na bumababa bilang ashfall; mahalagang magsuot ng mask para hindi makalanghap nito.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Patingin ng bulkan na pumuputok!

Heto ang pumuputok na bulkan — umiilanlang ang abo at usok mula rito!

[image: An erupting volcano with smoke and ash rising from its crater.]
